# Docs — Notion snapshots

These files are **re-exported snapshots from Notion**, which is the source of truth:

- `decisionlog.md` — the decision register (ADRs).
- `backlog.md` — the feature backlog, grouped by version.
- `experiencelog.md` — SE-relevant work by session.

**Do not edit these files directly.** Make changes in Notion and re-export; a
manual edit here will be overwritten by the next snapshot.
